_help: Edit this file to change site-wide text and contact details. Leave a value as an empty string to hide it. Run `npm run launch-check` before going live.

brand.name: Bloom
brand.mission: Providing compassionate psychological support, understanding, and connection for people navigating life after losing someone they love to suicide.
brand.description: Bloom offers compassionate psychological support, understanding and connection for people navigating life after losing someone they love to suicide.

contact.responseTime: We aim to reply within a few working days. We are not an emergency service.

organisation._note: Only fill these in with details you can document. The site never claims registration, accreditation or charitable status unless you add it here.

about.bioPlaceholderNote: The practitioner biography has not been added yet.

donations.usesStatement: Gifts help Bloom keep its support, resources and storytelling spaces open and thoughtfully run. Bloom does not publish donation totals, and a gift does not guarantee any outcome for any person.

howGiftsAreUsed.title: Keeping support accessible
howGiftsAreUsed.text: Contributing towards the cost of support sessions and groups, so cost is less of a barrier to people who need them.

howGiftsAreUsed.title: Resources and education
howGiftsAreUsed.text: Producing and reviewing guides for bereaved people and the family and friends who want to support them.

howGiftsAreUsed.title: Stories, with care
howGiftsAreUsed.text: Hosting, moderating and protecting the written, video and photo stories that contributors choose to share.

privacy._note: Draft retention periods are suggestions only. Confirm or change them, have the notice reviewed by a qualified legal adviser, then set legallyReviewed to true.

retention.contactMessages: up to 12 months after we last replied
retention.storySubmissions: until you withdraw them or we decline them (declined submissions are deleted within 90 days)
retention.donationRecords: for the period required by accounting and tax rules that apply to Bloom (to be confirmed)
